paragraphs: Shake Shack Inc. was formed on September 23, 2014 as a Delaware corporation for the purpose of facilitating an initial public offering and other related transactions in order to carry on the business of SSE Holdings, LLC and its subsidiaries ("SSE Holdings"). Shake Shack Inc. is the sole managing member of SSE Holdings and, as sole managing member, it operates and controls all of the business and affairs of SSE Holdings. As a result, Shake Shack Inc. consolidates the financial results of SSE Holdings and reports a non-controlling interest representing the economic interest in SSE Holdings held by the other members of SSE Holdings. Shake Shack Inc. Class A common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "SHAK." Unless the context otherwise requires, "we," "us," "our," "Shake Shack," the "Company" and other similar references refer to Shake Shack Inc. and, unless otherwise stated, all of its subsidiaries, including SSE Holdings.

Shake Shack serves modern, fun and elevated versions of American classics using only premium ingredients. We are known for our made-to-order Angus beef burgers, crispy chicken, hand-spun milkshakes, house-made lemonades, beer, wine, and more. With our fine-dining roots and a commitment to crafting uplifting experiences, Shake Shack has become a cult brand. Our purpose is to Stand For Something Good®, from premium ingredients and employee development to inspiring designs and community investment.

Originally founded in 2001 by Danny Meyer's Union Square Hospitality Group ("USHG"), which owns and operates some of New York City's most acclaimed and popular restaurants — such as Union Square Cafe and Gramercy Tavern, to name a few — Shake Shack began as a hot dog cart to support the rejuvenation of New York City's Madison Square Park through its Conservancy's first art installation, "I Y Taxi." The cart was an instant success, with lines forming daily throughout the summer months over the next three years. In response, the city's Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Shake Shack a contract to create a kiosk to help fund the park's future. In 2004, Shake Shack officially opened. It soon became a gathering place for locals and visitors alike, and a beloved New York City institution, garnering significant media attention, critical acclaim and a passionately devoted following. Since the original Shack opened in 2004 in Madison Square Park, the Company has expanded to 659 Shacks system-wide, of which 373 were Company-operated Shacks and 286 were licensed Shacks, including Shacks across London, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Singapore, Mexico City, Istanbul, Dubai, Tokyo, Seoul and more. Unless the context otherwise requires or unless specific reference is made to our licensed business, statements in this Part I of our Annual Report on Form 10-K refer to Shake Shack's Company-operated business.

Our Purpose — Stand for Something Good: We will nurture the world's communities by delivering exceptional food and hospitality. Everything that we do should be in service of our team members, guests, and communities. Our prosperity is a means to an end, with the end being improving the world in which we work, live, and play.

Our Mission — To bring the world's best fine casual experience to as many guests, team members, and communities as possible and, in doing so, to bring pride to everyone in our company and to deliver a strong financial benefit for our team members and shareholders.

To ensure the near-term and long-term success of our business, we are focused on recruiting, developing. and rewarding high performing teams. Our teams are made up of people who have integrity, who are warm, motivated, self-aware, and intellectually curious alongside having the competencies and skills that continue to foster our growth. We believe this culture is fundamental to the way we operate our business, and a key driver of our ability to deliver great guest experiences, and therefore, successfully grow our footprint.
As of December 31, 2025, we had 13,873 team members, of whom 13,427 were hourly team members and Shack-level managers and 446 were Shack Support Center personnel.

We attract and recruit a workforce of top talent through employer branding, diversification of recruitment channels, and optimal recruiting practices to create a talent pipeline to support current staffing needs as well as enabling new Shack growth. At Shake Shack we foster an environment that attracts and welcomes individuals of all abilities, backgrounds, cultures, perspectives, skill sets, and experiences. Having a high performing and engaged workforce is important, and we seek to understand the needs of our teams through feedback to help to ensure they feel recognized, connected and proud to work at Shake Shack.

We are dedicated to providing content and experiences that develop and retain team members. At Shake Shack, we continue to rethink how we provide career growth opportunities with lattice mobility replacing the traditional promotion ladder to ensure team members continue to succeed in a market that is rapidly changing. We offer training programs to foster leaders from within, such as:

▪Our nine-week Rise program is created for exempt managers and California non-exempt managers and focuses on elevating leadership capabilities through coaching, building effective team environments, and driving meaningful business impact within the Shack.

▪Our nine-week Emerge program is targeted towards assistant general managers and is designed to empower them to influence their teams, drive accountability and deliver results through strategic, data-informed decisions.

▪Our 18-week Shift Up program is a leadership development program for early career Shack managers that provides training through cohort mentoring, business integration and real-world Shack experience to help improve their skill sets and grow their confidence to become senior leaders in our Shacks.

To make sure every Shake Shack team member at every level has a positive experience, we strive to build an inclusive workplace, where all team members have the support and resources they need to succeed and feel a sense of belonging. We foster this sense of belonging in part through our employee resource groups, which are open to all team members. Another way we support our team members is through the administration of our HUG Fund, a 501(c)(3) organization funded by and available for our team members. The HUG Fund provides timely financial assistance to team members impacted by emergency circumstances beyond their control and means.

We care about our team and are committed to setting them up for success at Shake Shack and in their future careers. In fiscal 2025, we promoted 3,720 people throughout our Company. We are proud of our leaders who graduate from hourly roles to managers, managers to General Managers and General Managers to regional leadership. This year, 61% of our new General Managers and 63% of new Area Directors were promoted from within.

Our long-term success is dependent on the selection, design and execution of appropriate business strategies.
Our primary growth strategy is highly dependent on the availability of suitable locations and our ability to develop and open new Shacks on a timely basis and on terms attractive to us.
Our plans to open new Shacks, the ongoing need for capital expenditures at our existing Shacks and our ongoing digital enhancements require us to spend capital.
Our expansion into new domestic markets may present increased risks, which could affect our profitability.
Our failure to manage our growth effectively could harm our business and operating results.
New Shacks, once opened, may not be profitable, and may negatively affect Shack sales at our existing Shacks.
Our marketing strategies and channels will evolve and our programs may not be successful.
Our purpose to Stand For Something Good subjects us to risks.
If we fail to maintain our corporate culture, our relationships with our team members and guests could be negatively affected.
Incidents involving food safety and food-borne illnesses could adversely affect guests' perception of our brand, result in lower sales and increase operating costs.
Rising labor costs and difficulties recruiting and retaining the right team members could adversely affect our business.
Increased food commodity and energy costs could decrease our Restaurant-level profit margins or cause us to limit or otherwise modify our menu, which could adversely affect our business.
The digital and delivery strategy, related expenses, execution and expansion thereof, is uncertain and subject to risk.
We face significant competition for guests, and if we are unable to compete effectively, our business could be adversely affected.
Pandemics or disease outbreaks, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, have disrupted, and may continue to disrupt our business, results of operations and our financial condition.
We are subject to risks associated with leasing property subject to long-term leases.
The increasing focus on environmental, sustainability, social and governance matters could increase our costs, harm our reputation and adversely impact our business and financial results.
paragraphs: Described below are risks that we believe apply to our business and the industry in which we operate. You should carefully consider each of the following risk factors in conjunction with other information provided in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and in our other public disclosures. The risks described below highlight potential events, trends, or other circumstances that could adversely affect our business, reputation, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, liquidity or access to sources of financing, and consequently, the market value of our Class A common stock. These risks could cause our future results to differ materially from historical results and from guidance we may provide regarding our expectations of future financial performance. The risks described below are not the only risks we may face and additional risks not currently known to us or that we presently deem immaterial may emerge or become material at any time.

Our business is subject to a number of risks, including risks that may prevent us from achieving our business objectives or may adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations. These risks are discussed more fully below and include, but are not limited to the following:
▪Our long-term success is dependent on the selection, design and execution of appropriate business strategies.
▪Our primary growth strategy is highly dependent on the availability of suitable locations and our ability to develop and open new Shacks on a timely basis and on terms attractive to us.
▪Our plans to open new Shacks, the ongoing need for capital expenditures at our existing Shacks and our ongoing digital enhancements require us to spend capital.
▪Our expansion into new domestic markets may present increased risks, which could affect our profitability.

paragraphs: Shake Shack Inc. 於 2014 年 9 月 23 日成立為一家特拉華州公司，目的是為了促進首次公開發行及相關交易，以進行 SSE Holdings, LLC 及其子公司（"SSE Holdings"）的業務。Shake Shack Inc. 是 SSE Holdings 唯一的管理成員，作為唯一管理成員，其經營並控制 SSE Holdings 的所有業務與事務。因此，Shake Shack Inc. 合併 SSE Holdings 的財務結果，並報告非控制性權益，代表 SSE Holdings 其他成員所持有的經濟權益。Shake Shack Inc. 的 A 級普通股在紐約證券交易所交易，代碼為 "SHAK"。除非上下文另有說明，"we"、"us"、"our"、"Shake Shack"、"the Company" 及其他類似參考皆指 Shake Shack Inc.，除非另有說明，亦包括其所有子公司，包括 SSE Holdings。
Shake Shack 提供現代、有趣且升級版的美國經典美食，僅使用高品質原料。我們以現點現做 Angus 牛肉漢堡、酥脆雞肉、手製奶昔、自製檸檬汁、啤酒、葡萄酒等聞名。憑藉我們的高級餐廳根基與致力於打造提升體驗的承諾，Shake Shack 已成為一個cult品牌。我們的使命是 Stand For Something Good®，從高品質原料與員工發展，到啟發性設計與社區投資。

Shake Shack 最初於 2001 年由 Danny Meyer 的 Union Square Hospitality Group（"USHG"）創立，該集團擁有並營運紐約市一些最受好評與熱門的餐廳，例如 Union Square Cafe 和 Gramercy Tavern 等。Shake Shack 最初是以熱狗推車的形式開始，用以支持紐約市 Madison Square Park 的復興，透過其 Conservancy 的首個藝術裝置 "I Y Taxi"。這輛推車立刻獲得成功，接下來的三個夏天每天都排隊人潮不斷。作為回應，紐約市的公園與 recreation 部門授予 Shake Shack 合約，以建立一個攤位來協助公園的未來資金。2004 年，Shake Shack 正式開幕。很快地，它成為當地居民與遊客聚集的地方，並成為紐約市受愛戴的機構，獲得廣泛的媒體關注、評論界好評與忠實的追隨者。自 2004 年原 Shack 在 Madison Square Park 開幕以來，本公司已擴展至全球 659 家 Shack，其中 373 家為本公司經營的 Shack，286 家為授權經營的 Shack，包括倫敦、香港、上海、新加坡、墨西哥城、伊斯坦堡、迪拜、東京、首爾等地的 Shack。除非上下文另有說明或特別提及我們的授權業務，本年度報告 10-K 第一部分的內容皆指 Shake Shack 的本公司經營業務。
我們的使命 — Stand for Something Good：我們將透過提供卓越的美食與服務，來培育世界各地的社區。我們所做的每一件事都應以我們的員工、顧客與社區為服務對象。我們的繁榮只是達到目標的手段，目標是改善我們工作、生活與娛樂的環境。
我們的使命 — 將世界上最好的輕奢體驗帶給盡可能多的顧客、員工與社區，並在這個過程中為公司內所有成員帶來自豪感，同時為我們的員工與股東帶來強勁的財務效益。
為確保我們業務的短期與長期成功，我們專注於招募、培訓與獎勵高績效團隊。我們的團隊由具備誠信、溫暖、動力、自省與求知慾，同時擁有持續促進我們成長的專業能力與技能的人員組成。我們相信這種文化是我們運作業務的基礎，也是我們能夠提供卓越顧客體驗，並成功擴張業務的重要驅動力。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們共有 13,873 名員工，其中 13,427 名為時薪員工及 Shack 級管理人員，446 名為 Shack 支援中心人員。
我們透過僱主品牌、招聘渠道的多樣化以及最佳招聘實踐，吸引並招募頂尖人才，以建立人才管道，支持現有人力需求，並促進新 Shack 的擴張。在 Shake Shack，我們營造一個吸引並歡迎所有能力、背景、文化、觀點、技能與經驗的個人的環境。擁有高績效且投入的員工非常重要，我們透過反饋來瞭解團隊需求，以確保他們感到被認可、連結並為能在 Shake Shack 工作而感到自豪。
我們致力於提供內容與體驗，以培養並留住團隊成員。在 Shake Shack，我們持續重新思考如何提供職業發展機會，以網格式晉升制度取代傳統的晉升階梯，以確保團隊成員能在快速變化的市場中持續成功。我們提供培訓計畫，以從內部培育領導者，例如：
▪ 我們的九週 Rise 計畫是為豁免職務管理階層及加州非豁免職務管理階層所設計，專注於透過指導、建立有效的團隊環境，並推動有意義的業務影響，以提升領導能力。
▪ 我們的九週 Emerge 計畫針對助理總經理，設計用以賦予他們影響團隊、推動責任感並交付成果的能力，透過戰略且基於數據的決策。
▪ 我們的十八週 Shift Up 計畫是為早期職涯的 Shack 管理階層所設計的領導力發展計畫，透過同儕導師、業務整合及實際 Shack 經驗提供培訓，以幫助改善其技能並提升信心，成為我們 Shack 的高階領導者。

為確保每位 Shake Shack 團隊成員在各個層級都能有正面的體驗，我們致力於建立一個包容的工作環境，讓所有團隊成員都能獲得所需的支援與資源以成功並感受到歸屬感。我們透過員工資源羣組來培養這種歸屬感，這些羣組對所有團隊成員開放。另一種我們支援團隊成員的方式是透過我們 HUG Fund 的管理，這是一個 501(c)(3) 組織，由我們團隊成員資助並為他們所使用。HUG Fund 提供及時的財務援助，以協助因超出其控制範疇的緊急情況而受影響的團隊成員。
我們關心團隊成員，並致力於為他們在 Shake Shack 以及未來職業生涯中設置成功條件。在財務 2025 年，我們在本公司內共晉升了 3,720 名員工。我們為從小時工晉升為管理階層、管理階層晉升為總經理，以及總經理晉升為區域領導階層的領導者感到驕傲。今年，我們新任總經理中有 61% 是從內部晉升，新任區域總監中有 63% 是從內部晉升。

我們的長期成功取決於選擇、設計及執行適當的商業策略。
我們的主要成長策略高度依賴合適的場地 availability 以及我們開發並及時開設新 Shacks 的能力，且條件對我們而言具吸引力。
我們開設新 Shacks 的計畫、現有 Shacks 連續的資本支出需求以及持續的數位升級，需要我們投入資本。
我們擴張至新的國內市場可能會帶來更高的風險，這可能會影響我們的獲利能力。
我們若無法有效管理成長，可能會損害我們的業務及營運結果。
新開設的Shack在營運後可能無法獲利，並可能對本公司現有Shack的銷售造成負面影響。
本公司行銷策略與通路將持續演進，且相關方案可能無法達成預期成效。
本公司以Stand For Something Good為宗旨，此一立場可能使本公司面臨相關風險。
若本公司未能維持企業文化，將可能對與員工及顧客的關係造成負面影響。
涉及食品安全及食源性疾病事件可能不利於客人對我們品牌的看法，導致銷售額降低並增加營運成本。
勞動成本上升及招募與留住合適團隊成員的困難可能不利於我們的業務。
食品原物料及能源成本上升可能降低我們餐廳層面的毛利邊際，或導致我們限制或修改餐點，這可能不利於我們的業務。
數位化與外送策略、相關費用、執行與擴張，其成效與風險不確定。
我們面臨來自客人端的激烈競爭，若無法有效競爭，可能不利於我們的業務。
疫情或疾病爆發，例如 COVID-19 疫情，已幹擾並可能繼續幹擾本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況。
本公司面臨因租賃長期租約不動產而產生的風險。
對環境、永續性、社會及治理議題的關注度日益增加，可能提高本公司成本、損害本公司聲譽，並對本公司業務及財務結果產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 下列為我們認為適用於我們業務及我們所從事產業之風險。您應仔細考量下列風險因素，並配合本年度10-K表報表及其他公開揭露資訊一併參考。下列所描述之風險突顯了可能對我們業務、聲譽、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流、流動性或取得資金來源之潛在事件、趨勢或其他情況，進而影響本公司A類普通股之市場價值。這些風險可能導致我們未來之結果與歷史結果或我們對未來財務表現之預期有重大差異。下列所描述之風險並非我們可能面臨之唯一風險，且未來可能出現目前未為我們所知或目前認為不重要之其他風險，這些風險可能在任何時間點變得重要。
我們之業務面臨許多風險，包括可能使我們無法達成業務目標或對我們業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生負面影響之風險。這些風險在下文有更詳細之討論，包括但不限於以下內容：
▪ 我們之長期成功取決於選擇、設計及執行適當之業務策略。
▪ 我們之主要成長策略高度依賴合適之場地可得性，以及我們開發並在合適時間及對我們而言有吸引力之條件下開設新Shacks之能力。
▪ 我們開設新Shacks之計畫、現有Shacks之持續資本支出需求，以及持續之數位升級，需要我們進行資本支出。
▪ 我們擴張至新國內市場可能帶來增加之風險，這些風險可能影響我們之獲利能力。
